items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: He turned out to be a great man until Hitler come along and run us both out of there.

ctx.x: But, in going back to Europe -- I went back for Paul Spadoni, and the man, the errand boy that he sent -- a fellow named Eddie Dussberg -- to meet us in Hamburg, this fellow turned out by using my band as a battle ram. He turned out to have the biggest theater, the Winter Garden theater, in Berlin. Of the vaudeville houses, see. And he turned out to be a great man until Hitler come along and run us both out of there.
Well, let's get back to Europe, when you came back. Who was with you when you went back to Europe in 1927?
